items.description: Plans the visual layer for the social content pipeline. Spawned by 00-social-content between Phase 5.0 and Phase 5.5. items.description: Turns ONE reference image into ONE ship-ready template. Spawned by the 00-social-content orchestrator during onboarding (template-building Step O3.6) — ONE invocation per REF. AI-FIRST: the AI generates by default (composition, text-fit, overlap, font); HTML is the surgical exception. The ref image IS the composition guide — fed back as --input-image while the prompt states only the delta. Flow: identify the form (tree) → write rationale.md FIRST (BLOCKING reasoning step, gated by Check A) → read ONLY that scenario → invoke its edit mode + craft → template.html → preview → automatic quality gate (incl. Check B treatment-contract) → return template + rationale. Reads layered references under template-authoring/; the orchestrator + by-eye golden-set are the final QA.
